REQ-01 was approved at the PM gate after that draft was written, so the status is out of date. The ticket row now gives only the category, qualifier and roadmap link. That field (expected_type) is an expected or oracle value, not a tag on the ticket, so the classification no longer relies on it. The New Feature category rests only on what the change requests do (feat.intake) and the add-only architecture rule (org.architecture). Everything else is unchanged from the previous attempt: the CR-4 provider/model scope fix, a Technical sub-category for each CR, the Not Technical Only qualifier, no duplicates merged, related items grouped, and the impacted repositories taken from the routing maps. All cited requirement files were opened with Read in this session. I rewrote the file in full.

The output itself says at line 59 that ZD-48600 'does not touch max_tokens'. Its only link is indirect, through PROV-ACME-2026-11, so calling it related by 'shared rule or shared code' is not supported. The list also leaves out ZD-48455, even though line 56 and feat.prebacklog ('Related items') treat it as related because of the overlapping 'overdue risk' wording and class names. The grouping summary contradicts the duplicate-check table.

judge.notes: Both refusal points are fixed. The pre-backlog status claim and the 'type tag' claim are gone, and line 3 now uses the brief's gate wording. I checked every quoted string against its source and they match: ZD-48600 CR-1 to CR-7, the T2 risk text, 'Keep every existing signature; add new functions', the ZD-48501/ZD-48211 overdue wording, the ZD-48455 classes, ZD-48470 feed v2 currency, PROV-ACME-2026-11 (acme-text-3, deprecated 2026-12-01, system field, max_tokens 300), FIN-OPS-2026-07 (300 to 200, 'No code or behaviour change...'), ZD-48510 payment execution, and the summaries of ZD-48377, RETRO-2026-19, ZD-48480 and REG-LPR-2026-4.2. The claim 'compared with every other intake item; all are open' holds: requirements/ has 12 files, the 11 others are each covered, and every one has status: open. 'Four new functions' is correct. The routing table matches the feature override, and the remark that org/org.routing_map.md lists only ap_aging is correct. 'Impacted repositories: ap_pipeline, ap_forecast, ap_aging, ap_portal' matches the source repos field and the routing map. Category New Feature and qualifier 'Not Technical Only' are reasoned design choices and are labelled as the agent's judgement. 'Enhancement within the feature' for CR-4 is also a judgement, covered by the line 36 disclaimer. The api:github GET-only limitation and the decision to treat this file as the ticket record follow from the brief. Open questions OQ-1 to OQ-4 are sound, and Q-1 to Q-5 are carried forward faithfully from feat.prebacklog. The workbook outcome is met: the entry is classified by category, the duplicate check is done and nothing was merged, and the related items are grouped for later steps. The one weakness is the inconsistent summary line for related items: it includes FIN-OPS-2026-07 and leaves out ZD-48455.
